cohort: 1252 women competing in powerlifting, weightlifting, or CrossFit
finding: Both the number of births and mode of birth were associated with the likelihood of urinary incontinence in resistance-trained women.
mod_finding: Women who had experienced only caesarean births had the lowest likelihood of urinary incontinence, while women who had experienced both vaginal and caesarean births had the most severe and second highest likelihood of urinary incontinence.
